title: Repair the compare-screen empty-from assertion: exercise the mixed-date branch the label lives in
objective: Fix the single failing web test (apps/web/src/components/compare/__tests__/compare-screen.test.tsx, 'treats an EMPTY competing-rule field as absent, not just a null one'): the test blanks rules[0].effective_from on a fixture rule whose effective_to is ALREADY absent, so the accepted component's DELIBERATE both-absent collapse ('no effective dates are recorded for this rule' - endorsed by the adjacent passing test and the component's own G-wave comment) renders instead of the per-slot 'from not stated' label the assertion expects. Preserve the test's intent (an empty STRING labels as not-stated) by deriving a real effective_to for rules[0] from the sibling rule's fixture date (never an invented literal), so the empty-string FROM renders through the per-slot branch and the assertion becomes correct and meaningful. TEST-ONLY: no component change (the component behavior is accepted M5-T004 design); no other test touched. Verification is CI-ONLY (thin client has no node_modules): the web-e2e job turning green (vitest 390/390) is the executable proof.
business_reason: This is the last non-owner-gated CI red: web-e2e has failed on exactly this assertion since M5-T004 was accepted (post-acceptance discovery - follow-up task per house rule, never reopening accepted work). Repairing it makes web-e2e green so the upcoming address-entry/confirm-screen UI packet gets clean execution proof, leaving only the two genuinely owner-gated reds (npm audit RCE authorization; control-plane digest normalization decision).
